description:
BROE auctioneers are delighted to present this well-proportioned three-bedroom mid-terrace residence, ideally situated on the ever-popular Cherryfield Road. Offering generous living accommodation and exceptional potential, this property is the perfect opportunity for first-time buyers, growing families, or those looking to create their forever home. The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a bright and spacious living room, dining room, a kitchen area, upstairs are three well-proportioned bedrooms, and a family bathroom.
To the rear, the property benefits from a private garden with the added advantage of a substantial garage accessed via a rear laneway, providing secure off-street parking, additional storage, or excellent potential for a workshop or home office. While the property would benefit from modernisation, it offers an excellent blank canvas, allowing the new owner to design and finish the home to their own taste. With its solid structure, generous proportions, and highly sought-after location, this home has all the ingredients to become a fantastic family home. Cherryfield Road enjoys a mature residential setting with an excellent range of amenities close by, including schools, shops, parks, sports facilities, and public transport links. Dublin City Centre is easily accessible, while the M50 and Naas Road network are just a short drive away, making commuting straightforward. Viewing highly recommended. 

Contact Craig Leap of BROE auctioneers to register your interest.
